question: Avocado Oil Peru
markdown:
Peru
is a major global producer and exporter of avocados
, increasingly processing surplus and local fruit into high-quality culinary and cosmetic-grade cold-pressed avocado oil
. International brands and local valleys utilize sustainable methods—including zero-waste processing of whole or declassified fruits—to export virgin and refined oils worldwide.
Eximpedia
Production and Sourcing
Major processing occurs near agricultural hubs like Lima and regional valleys.
Producers utilize advanced centrifugation and cold-press techniques
Sustainable models repurpose non-exportable or declassified fresh fruit to minimize waste.
Brands like
⁠La Tourangelle
highlight local milling operations in Peru to maintain direct supply chain integration.
La Tourangelle
